status: explicit experiment plan, not executed and not an AutoML search
data_version_requirement: Freeze quality_v2 first. Refit all v1-trained neural weights and all v1 context/scaler/cache state. Vendor pretrained weights may remain unchanged.

initial_gpu.first_step: Run a CUDA memory preflight with own validation queries, estimator_batch_size=1, then choose context/batch size. Do not begin a long paid reservation before data/quality freeze.

future_neural_training.applies_to: Future gradient training and any explicitly supported foundation fine-tuning. These settings do not retroactively change the submitted v1 models.
future_neural_training.historical_v1_small_neural_training: 8 epochs, AdamW; the first submitted candidate has not been retrained under the new settings.
future_neural_training.foundation_fine_tuning_requirement: A separate supported trainer with Adam, validation, checkpointing and early stopping is required before claiming gradient fine-tuning. Frozen ICL fit alone does not fine-tune weights.

frozen_ICL_training_semantics.fit_means: Prepare the labeled training context, feature transformations and inference caches using fixed vendor weights.

capacity_candidate_note: Counts are exact instantiated module counts. Only the original small widths and TabM256/16 have been CPU evaluated. Existing make_model currently hardcodes some small widths, so broader capacity runs require an explicit runner update before execution.

selection.calibration: separate calibration with source-group cross-fitting preferred
selection.final_assessment: held-out source/deployment; no subsequent tuning on it
selection.overfit_monitor: train-source probe versus held-source validation and learning curves, not model-parameter/input-scalar ratios
selection.foundation_train_error: Do not predict context rows with their own labels available; use independent training-source mixtures or leave-one-out context
